ns2:section.sectionText: Description: This class will focus on the History of the 1960s, a tumultuous decade in the social and political history of the United States. The first part of the semester will be devoted to the Civil Rights movement. Government policy, the Vietnam War and urban unrest will take up the middle of the semester. The last third of the class will be devoted to the cultural and social diversity that developed as a result of the fragmentation within the Civil Rights movement.
